cases.input: An authorized feature task requires: Implement and verify accessible frontend interactions through native semantics, meaningful names, keyboard/focus behavior and explicit assistive-technology limits.
cases.expected: Inspect the actual stack, implement the bounded domain procedure, exercise its relevant acceptance flow and preserve untested boundaries.

cases.input: A dialog opens from an icon-only action but has no accessible title, loses the trigger on close and leaves keyboard focus behind the overlay.
cases.expected: Give the action and dialog names, use a qualified focus pattern, test dismissal/return focus, and record any untested assistive-technology coverage.

cases.input: Correct punctuation in a plain-text changelog unrelated to this frontend feature.
cases.expected: Make only the requested text edit. Do not install a library, restructure the UI, change tokens or run unrelated browser effects.
